name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light conditions and make interactive data visualizations pop, aligning with Manus’ competitive edge. The toggle respects user preference without cluttering the interface. Trade-off: some users in bright environments may prefer light mode upfront, but the toggle ensures flexibility.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes hide errors and muted colors—users miss critical data if they assume the interface is working. A better alternative is a high-contrast light theme with a one-click dark toggle, ensuring visibility isn’t sacrificed for style. Settle it with user testing: measure error detection rates in both themes under varied lighting conditions.
